data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 晨光被单的永恒誓言
data.description: 清晨纯净的曦光透过窗帘缝隙，将纯白的大床染得一片明亮通透。雪菜双手轻拉着棉被护在胸前，露出白皙光洁的双肩与如雪的锁骨。黑发散乱在枕榻上，眼角因动情而泛着晶莹的水光，她微红着脸颊，带着无可替代的娇羞与坚定轻声低喃，宣誓永远陪伴在所爱之人身边。
data.location: sunlit morning bedroom with rumpled white linen sheets
data.action: clutching white bedsheet to chest, bare shoulders and collarbone exposed, black hair splayed on pillow, tear of happiness in eye, sweet blushing confession smile
data.lighting: bright pristine morning sunbeams pouring into the room
data.mood: pure matrimonial devotion, radiant tender happiness
data.promptProse: Clutching a crisp white bedsheet to her chest as morning sunbeams illuminate the room, Yukina smiles through happy tears. Her bare shoulders glow softly as she looks forward with unwavering devotion.
data.animaCaption: Yukina clutching a white sheet to her chest in morning light, smiling with happy tears.
